name: Uravi Defence & Technology Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2004, Uravi T & Wedge Lamps Ltd manufactures automotive component for OEM and aftermarket sectors. Under the brand name "UVAL," the company offers a range of automotive lighting products, including
stoplights, taillights, indicators, and wedge base lamps. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
The company, an ISO/TS certified manufacturer with product approvals from the Automotive Research Association of India and E-mark, specializes in Stop & Tail, Signal/Indicator lamps, and Wedge lamps for two-wheelers, four-wheelers, tractors, and industrial applications. Operating under the UVAL brand, it provides customized lighting solutions to both OEMs and the aftermarket segment.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.37 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -11.9%
